subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should structured usage be added to `session_status.details`, exposed through a separate agent-facing usage tool, or remain operator-only?
rationale: The repository has reusable structured usage data but no established model-facing contract; this choice determines schema size, privacy boundaries, freshness semantics, and long-term API compatibility.

options.title: Extend status details
options.body: Add a compact additive `details.usage` contract while preserving the existing rendered status text and visibility checks.

options.title: Add a usage tool
options.body: Create a separate narrowly scoped tool if aggregation filters or schema size would make `session_status` too broad.

options.title: Keep operator-only
options.body: Retain structured usage in Gateway and UI surfaces without exposing raw usage data to agent tools.

recommendation.title: Extend status details
recommendation.body: Add a compact additive `details.usage` contract while preserving the existing rendered status text and visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This core agent-tool contract spans session status, usage aggregation, and access-policy areas connected to this person's recent history and prior review.
